lines: Hi. What can I do for you?
I have a reservation for the pottery workshop at two.
Sure. What name is it under?
Alex Morgan. There should be two of us.
Yes, I've got you both here. Is the other person with you?
She's parking the car. Should I wait here?
Please do. I'll show you both to the studio when she gets here.
Great. She'll only be a minute.

realizations.actualText: What can I do for you?

lines: Not yet. I came straight from work.
There's some rice in the fridge. We could heat up the leftovers from last night.
What's in the sauce? I'm allergic to peanuts.
I'm not sure. My roommate made it, so let's leave that.
I brought a sandwich, actually. I'll have that.
Want to sit here? I'll heat up my dinner.
Sure. I could use a break.
It would really help if you could turn the music down. I'm trying to finish this report.
I'm learning this song for tomorrow, and I can barely hear the guitar part as it is.
I hear you. Would headphones work, or do you need to play along out loud?
Headphones would work. Mine just ran out of battery.
You can use my wired ones. They're by the laptop.
Great. I should be finished in about an hour.

realizations.actualText: It would really help if you could turn the music down

lines: She's out at the moment. Can I take a message?
Yes, this is Leo from the print shop. Her posters are ready, but we close at four today.
Four today. And they're ready to collect now?
That's right. I'll be here until then.
Thanks. I'll pass along your message when she gets back in a few minutes.
Okay. I'll let her know about the early closing.
I'm looking for a black notebook, the small one with plain pages.
We're sold out of the small ones. Would the larger size work?
Maybe. Do you have any black ones left?
Just one. Let me get it off the shelf for you.
Thanks. I need it to fit in this bag.
You can try it. It's a bit wider than the one you asked for.
Great. I'll ring it up over here.

realizations.actualText: I'm looking for a black notebook
Do you have any black ones left?
We're sold out of the small ones

lines: Are you still using my charger? Can I have it back? My phone's nearly dead.
Yeah, the one next to your laptop.
Oh, right. I'm just unplugging it. All yours.
Thanks. I need to charge my phone before I leave.
Sorry, I meant to return it earlier.
No problem. I've still got twenty minutes.
I'll clear a space by the outlet for you.
The reason I moved the meeting was—
But Tuesday was the only day I could—
I'm not done yet. I checked with the client, and Tuesday no longer works for them.
They offered Thursday morning or Friday afternoon. That's what I wanted to ask you about. Which works for you?
Friday afternoon. I'm away on Thursday.
Okay, I'll ask for Friday at two.
Do you think the new lunch delivery service is going to catch on?
It's too soon to tell. We only started it on Monday.
It was, but that was mostly people using the opening discount.
So we need to know if they'll order again at the regular price.
Exactly. Let's see what happens over the next two weeks.
Okay. I'll keep track of repeat orders.
Great. We can look at those numbers together.
The library was packed this morning.
Yeah, the school holidays started yesterday.
Speaking of which, are you still taking Friday off while the kids are home?
Just the afternoon. My sister can stay with them until lunch.
Would you like me to move our two o'clock meeting to the morning?
Could we do ten? I'll be in the office by then.
Ten works. I'll update the invitation.
Thanks. That makes Friday much easier.

drafts.scenario: 気まずい言い方の修復
lines: I'd like to have you over for dinner without all the other people.
That sounded better in my head. I meant just the two of us, so we can actually catch up.
Oh, instead of another big group dinner?
Exactly. We barely got to talk last time.
I'd like that. Are you free on Thursday?
I am. Come over around seven?

realizations.actualText: That sounded better in my head.

lines: I wish I hadn't bought this coffee maker. It doesn't fit under the kitchen shelf.
Let me get this straight. You bought it yesterday, and you haven't used it?
Right. But it was on sale, so I don't know if I can return it.
Returns within thirty days, unused, in the original box. Oh, sale items are included.
Have you still got the box?
Yeah, and all the packing. I can get the full ninety dollars back.
Cha-ching. Guess you're making a trip to the store.
After lunch. I'll measure the space before I buy another one.
Good idea. I'll help you pack this one up.
It's frustrating when someone presents your work without mentioning you.
Tell me about it. That happened to me last month. Was this about today's meeting?
Yeah. I built the budget model, but Sam presented it as his work.
Did the slides show who worked on it?
No. I want to ask him to add my name before he sends them out.
That sounds reasonable. You could point to the model and say you want your contribution included.
I'll talk to him this afternoon, before the slides go to the client.
Good. You'll have a specific change to ask for.
I fell off the wagon last night. I'd gone a whole week without snacking in front of the TV.
I put the bag of cookies next to the remote. I kept reaching for it without thinking.
Does that usually happen when you're watching something?
Yeah. I can keep the cravings at bay until the snacks are right in front of me.
Is there one thing you'd like to try tonight?
I'll leave the cookies in the cupboard instead of bringing the bag to the couch.
Okay. I'll leave them there too.

drafts.scenario: プロジェクトの立て直し
lines: Can you give me the situation in a nutshell?
We're behind on the paperwork, but the new system is starting to pay off. It passed the final checks this morning.
Okay. Then let’s get the ball rolling on the next phase.
Before we do, I want to make sure we’re all on the same page.
Fair. Do you want to delay the launch?
Your call. I can work with either option.
Let's keep the date, then. The system is ready, but we can't drop the ball on the paperwork. I'll finish it this afternoon.
Agreed. I’ll send everyone an updated plan.
Kudos on keeping this together, by the way.
Thanks. Ask me again after launch day.
We’re thinking of taking the train to the coast Saturday.
Not at all. The tickets are a little steep, though.
We could make a day of it and stay for dinner.
Absolutely. I get out of town once in a blue moon.
Then I'll book three tickets. Is the nine o'clock train okay for you?
Yes. Send me the price before you book, and I'll transfer you my share.
I’ll send you the train time tonight.
I’m getting a lot of heat from management over this mistake.
But it wasn’t just your mistake.
I’m leading the project. I have to shoulder some of the responsibility.
Sure, but the rest of us aren’t going to leave you high and dry.
We’re all in the same boat here.
I just don’t want anyone to think I sold them out.
We can explain who handled each part and where the mistake happened. That's different from blaming anyone.
I'll be there with you. I handled part of this too, and they need to hear that from me.

realizations.actualText: getting a lot of heat from management

drafts.scenario: プレッシャーに負けそうなとき
lines: You’ve barely said a word all morning.
I’m getting psyched out about the presentation.
You’ve done this a dozen times.
Not in front of this many executives.
You know the material. It's the questions afterward that are worrying you, isn't it?
If I freeze up, I’m going to get clobbered in the Q&A.
You won’t. And even if one question catches you off guard, take a second and think.
You can admit you're nervous and still give a good answer.
